purpose: The home page's 'Learn the basics' section (owner direction, November 26, 2026: the whole point is education; drop real knowledge, bust myths, explain basic terms, set context). Every line restates a reviewed record this site already publishes: terms come from data/knowledge.json (Cannabis 101), the federal and travel facts from the national records in data/state-permissions.json, and the state counts are computed from the state answers at build time. Each item carries the same sources as its record.

terms.text: Cannabis is the plant. Cannabinoids are compounds it makes, including THC and CBD.
THC is the main cannabinoid that gets you high. CBD doesn’t cause the same high, but it can still have side effects and interact with medicines.
The form of THC in the raw plant. Heat turns it into THC, which is why lab reports list both.
The compounds behind cannabis smell and flavor. A batch lab report shows which ones a product actually has.
Kief is the resin-rich dust shaken off the plant. Hash is that resin concentrated, often pressed.
A certificate of analysis records lab results for one batch. Make sure the batch on the report matches the batch you bought.

myths.myth: Legal in my state means legal everywhere.
myths.fact: Federal law still controls cannabis. In April 2026 medical products under a state license moved to Schedule III, but adult-use products did not. TSA says marijuana is still illegal under federal law, and screeners hand what they find to police.

myths.myth: If an edible hasn’t kicked in, take more.
myths.fact: Swallowed cannabis can take 30 minutes to 2 hours to start working, and the effects can last for hours. That delay is why people take too much.

myths.myth: CBD is harmless, so it can’t interact with anything.
myths.fact: CBD doesn’t get you high, but it can have side effects and interact with medicines. Tell your doctor or pharmacist if you use it.

myths.myth: The strain name tells you what’s in it.
myths.fact: A product’s name alone doesn’t tell you its chemistry. The lab report for that batch does.
